intro: Welcome to the Stone Steps. Two hundred terraces, one teapot, and never enough cups.
Tea, clay, dumplings and stones. Merge two of a kind and the climbers will thank you.
Isolde said the island council meets here.
It does, when the tea house has a roof. Help me fix it and I'll call them together.

tasks.title: Patch the tea house roof
dialogue: The storm took half the tiles. Rain in the teapot is not a flavour.
That's Pebble. Older than the steps. He approves of slow work.

tasks.title: Hang the iron kettle
dialogue: I'm Toma, the potter. I'll trade cups for dumplings, any day.
Toma's cups are the only ones that survive the stairs.

tasks.title: Light Toma's kiln
dialogue: My kiln has been cold since the spring dried up. No water, no clay.
The water's back now. Lantern Bay's light reached all the islands.

tasks.title: Set out low tables
dialogue: Vesna, island council. I hear you carry a logbook, a deed and a lighter.
And a fingerprint on a broken lens.
Then the council will listen. Bring everyone up the steps.

tasks.title: Rake the stone garden
dialogue: He moved. That means something important is about to happen.

tasks.title: Reopen the tea house
dialogue: The tea house is open! First pot is free for anyone who climbed.
Two hundred steps at my age. This tea had better be worth it.
The council meets tomorrow at dawn.

tasks.title: Prepare the council hall
dialogue: Every island sends one voice. We need seats for six.
Six islands. It's been one for so long.

tasks.title: Lay out the evidence
dialogue: The deed. The lighter. The logbook. Tobias's word. The fingerprint.
Rafe Holloway admits he took the boat for the deed. He swears someone else lit the fire.
Then he has to say who, in front of everyone.

tasks.title: Brew the council tea
dialogue: A strong pot. Hard truths go down easier with tea.
I made new cups. Six of them, one for each island.

tasks.title: Hold the hearing
dialogue: Rafe Holloway is called to answer. He is... not here.
His skiff left at first light. Heading for the Rope Isles.

tasks.title: Rebuild the steps bridge
dialogue: If you're crossing to the Rope Isles, take the high bridge. I'll fire stones for it.
He's coming with you. He's never left the steps before.

tasks.title: Hold the Lantern Climb
dialogue: Every terrace lit, from the sea to the summit.
The council stands with you, Nell. Bring him back to answer.
